phase_note: Exploration = cycle through every half-hour slot exactly once before repeating any (~48 days at 1 post/day). Once all 48 have at least one reading, switch phase to "exploit" and mostly reuse top performers, with occasional re-tests.
baseline_source: Documented general LinkedIn benchmark: (reactions+comments+shares)/impressions around 2 percent is commonly cited as solid organic performance for a small/niche B2B company page. This is NOT OpenRateLab-specific data, it is a placeholder until 10+ real posts give us our own observed average -- replace baseline_engagement_rate with that real average once available, and update baseline_source to say so.
geographic_note: LinkedIn Page Analytics (Analytics tab, Visitors / Followers) shows location breakdown once there is enough traffic for it to be meaningful. Check periodically (roughly monthly) once follower count is non-trivial, and bias future slot exploration toward the dominant region business hours. Not yet actionable at 0 followers.
